URC details X40 floor scrubber with a 40-litre tank and 6–8-hour runtime

LiDAR SLAM and a customized ROS 2 Nav2 stack support indoor commercial cleaning.

StartupPedia ↗16 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

Commercial cleaning focus

StartupPedia reports specifications for URC Robotics’ X40, intended for offices, hospitals, malls and industrial buildings. The company lists its headquarters in Jammu and manufacturing in Gujarat, India.

Water capacity and operating time

Published specifications give a 550 mm cleaning width, 800 mm suction width, 40-litre fresh-water tank and 45-litre recovery tank. Runtime is listed as 6–8 hours; these are specifications rather than independent results across all floor conditions.

Navigation and missing commercial details

LiDAR SLAM, 3D LiDAR and visual odometry work with a customized ROS 2 Nav2 stack for route planning and motion control. The report does not provide price, hourly cleaning coverage or a delivery date, leaving operating-cost comparisons unresolved.
